name: obs-multichat
description: Twitch, YouTube, Kick, TikTok and Starvios chats together in one dock and on your scene, with viewers, date and time, and text-to-speech.
long_description: Detects which platforms you are live on, merges their chats in a dock and in a scene source (vertical or a horizontal ticker), shows the viewers of each channel, can read the chat aloud and tells you when there is a new version.
